## Path Models with simulated pi

Here we use simulated pi (mutational variance)

10 kb

```{r SEM-human-maps-10kb, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))
  
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()
  
  cat(paste("fitting SEM(s) -- ", u, sep=""))
  cat("\n")

  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
      
      tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb,
                         coverage > 0.75,
                         mut_map==u,
                         constrained_model==m,
                         demo==d) %>%
                         dplyr::select(., -starts_with("bin_")) 
      
      tbl_10kb_log <- cbind.data.frame(tbl_10kb[,1:3],
                        apply(tbl_10kb[,4:(ncol(tbl_10kb)-4)], 2, log))
      
      # because of 0's
      if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      } else {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      }
      
      # genome-wide models
      model_0 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
      "
      
      m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_1 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      "
      
      m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_2 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
      "
      
      m2gls <- sem(model_2,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m2gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_3 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
      "
      
      m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T), 
          paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_genomewide_",
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
      # one model per chrom
      for(c in 1:22) {
    
        model_0 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
        "
        
        m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m0gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_1 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        "
        
        m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                     data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_2 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6

        m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                     data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),

        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3gls, "r2")),

        fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-100kb, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
                        constrained_model==m,

                        apply(tbl_100kb[,4:(ncol(tbl_100kb)-4)], 2, log))

        tbl_100kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites) 
      } else {

      }
      
      # genome-wide models
      model_0 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
      "
      
      m0gls <- sem(model_0,

                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-1Mb, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "
        
        m2gls <- sem(model_2,
                     data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls)),
                                as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
        
        model_3 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "
        
        m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                     data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                                as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
        
        fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_chr",
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures,  include=F, message=F, warning=F}
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="LRT test of nested DAGs 2 & 3 (models fit per chromosome)",

      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),

          base_height=10, base_width=20)

          base_height=10, base_width=20)
```

```{r SEM-human-params,  include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# per chromosome SEM models, DAGs 0-1
## 10 kb
chr_params_10kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 0:1) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_10kb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}

                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_10kb$scale <- 1e+4

## 100 kb
chr_params_100kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_100kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_100kb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_100kb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_100kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_100kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_100kb$scale <- 1e+5

## 1 Mb
chr_params_1Mb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_1Mb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_1Mb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_1Mb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_1Mb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_1Mb$scale <- 1e+6

chr_params <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb,
                               chr_params_100kb,
                               chr_params_1Mb)  %>%
              filter(., pvalue < 0.05) %>%
              filter(., op=="~" | op==":=") 

chr_params_ext <- left_join(chr_params, 
                            chr_fitmeasures,
                            by=c("chrom", "DAG", "mut_map",
                                 "constrained_model", "demo", "scale"))

names(chr_params_ext)[8] <- "pvalue_est"
names(chr_params_ext)[21] <- "pvalue_DAG"
  
p <- ggplot(data=filter(chr_params_ext,
                        lhs=="pi_sim_tot", 
                        DAG==2), 
             aes(x=chrom, 
                 y=est, 
                 color=mut_map,
                 alpha=gfi,
                 shape=rhs)) +
      geom_point(size=2) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
      facet_grid(scale~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1, 2), name="Variable") +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"),
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="Path Coefficients to Pi (DAG 2, GFI > 0.95, pval_est < 0.05)",
           x="Chromosome", y="Direct Std. PC to Diversity") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),     
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),     
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_params_pi_DAG2_simpi.svg", p, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_params_pi_DAG2_simpi.pdf", p, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)

# ratios of PCs from B and Mu to Pi
chr_wide <- chr_params_ext %>% filter(., pvalue_est < 5e-2) %>%
         dplyr::select(., -c(op, label, se, z, pvalue_est, pvalue_DAG,
                             ci.lower, ci.upper)) %>%
         filter(., demo=="equilibrium", lhs=="pi_sim_tot") %>% 
         filter(., rhs=="avg_mut" | rhs=="B") %>%
         pivot_wider(values_from="est", names_from="rhs")
         #filter(., avg_mut >)
          
chr_wide$ratio_B_u <- chr_wide$B / chr_wide$avg_mut # chr 19 is weird!

r <- ggplot(data=chr_wide, 
             aes(x=chrom, 
                 y=ratio_B_u, 
                 color=mut_map,
                 alpha=gfi,
                 shape=as.factor(DAG))) +
      geom_point(size=2.5) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dashed") +
      facet_grid(scale~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1),
                         name="DAG") +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"), 
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="Ratio of Path Coefficients to Pi (GFI > 0.95, pval_est < 0.05)",
           x="Chromosome", y="PC(B) / PC(Mu)") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),  
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/sem_pcratios_pi_simpi.svg", sep=""),
          r, base_height=8, base_width=20)
save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/sem_pcratios_pi_simpi.pdf", sep=""),
          r, base_height=8, base_width=20)
```
